notes.title: A new version is available! (Beta 31.12.2020)
notes.content:
The development of this update took a very long time, as working with artificial intelligence (AI) for game characters is a very laborious process. In order to avoid bugs and problems with opponents, only the allied NPC (medic) has a new artificial intelligence (AI) so far. In future updates, the new AI will also be used for hostile characters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23352481/7d4b265c877646b47bd2dd41bceedac6fdec83ff.png[/img]

Improved sky and added volumetric clouds. Clouds can be reached and flown through, and the density of clouds depends on the weather.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23352481/19bce96c19b2bf8940405ab9a81bb051da56ccbd.png[/img]

The water was replaced with a better one, and preparations were made to add the underwater world, water and underwater transport and underwater colonies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23352481/4f1472faf96a24d7d3a1249a98962a702de206e4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23352481/81d4ced2adc10fcc2a80a1778168f47efae0c22e.png[/img]

Block structures now have finite health and can be destroyed. But opponents do not damage buildings yet, as the new AI is not yet sufficiently tested.

Added a new mode of building buildings similar to the games Ark / Rust / The forest / Grounded.

Some bugs fixed:
Fixed incorrect trajectory of the projectile when firing at a certain angle.
Fixed some issues with the power distribution system.
Improved optimization in buildings with a large number of light sources.
Fixed a construction bug due to which it was possible to build objects that intersect other buildings.

The Slovak language has also been added to the game, many thanks to Korienok for the translation provided!

The water was replaced with a better one, and preparations were made to add the underwater world, water and underwater transport and underwater colonies.

notes.title: A new version is available! (Beta 20.08.2019)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23352481/61fc15280fadd9971b0368cf194bddcef31845f1.gif[/img]
Fixed problems with controlling the character and sticking it to the walls during the jump. Fixed an issue with the camera when the character is knocked down. Added anti-gravity jetpack, which makes it easy to cope with the construction of buildings of any complexity. Fixed an issue where items used by the player became unavailable after the player's death. Added descriptions for most of the items in the encyclopedia. Added missing textures to new models. Fixed issue with beacon names when "Beacon"was always written instead of their names. Added an indicator of the integrity of items that can deteriorate, soon some tools will have a margin of safety and break. Now you can include a view from the cab, but while it is only available for the excavator, in the next update to the rest of the transport will also be possible to include the vish from the cab.

About errors, problems with the game or ideas on the development of the game, let me know by e-mail: illusoryworldsupprt@gmail.com

notes.title: Big update! A new version is available! (Beta 01.08.2019)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23352481/ca18c72aecd184ee37ffcfa9ac6fbc0c546e419c.png[/img]
In this update, the opportunity appeared to build in space, as well as create artificial gravity. Now you can change clothes and armor on your character, you can also create a spacesuit for flying in outer space. Improved construction of blocks, now you can put a group of blocks. Fixed the problem with the rescue capsule when the player died away from the starting island. Fixed a problem with the failure of pressing during construction. Improved effects when driving vehicles. Added damage and low health effects. Vehicles can now shoot down trees. Improved melee attack. Fixed problems with the encyclopedia, a description of all items will be available in the next update. Changed the length of the night, now the day lasts longer. Car suspension has been improved. New doors, a new spaceship, a space beacon and a gravity generator have been added.
Thank you for your support and feedback, thanks to you I continue to develop the game and make it better. I really appreciate your participation in the development of the project and I am always happy to hear your suggestions, comments and suggestions about the game.

About errors, problems with the game or ideas on the development of the game, let me know by e-mail: illusoryworldsupprt@gmail.com
